hooks.name: Prevent .env File Commits
hooks.description: Blocks write operations to .env files that might contain secrets, prompting for confirmation

action.prompt: Before writing to any file, check if the file path contains '.env' (but NOT '.env.example' or '.env.local.example'). If it's an actual .env file with real secrets/values, warn that secrets should not be committed and verify the write is intentional. Only block if the content appears to contain real API keys, passwords, or tokens (not placeholder values).
